title: Spiderweb Nanomechanical Resonators via Bayesian Optimization: Inspired by Nature and Guided by Machine Learning.
summary: The primary author-deposited paper identifies learned-surrogate optimization; fabricated spiderweb resonators exhibited torsional soft-clamping and room-temperature quality factors above one billion.

evidence.tested: The primary author-deposited paper identifies learned-surrogate optimization; fabricated spiderweb resonators exhibited torsional soft-clamping and room-temperature quality factors above one billion.
evidence.unknown: The date refers to the cited version. Earlier public versions and independent replication were not systematically verified.
evidence.ai_role: Gaussian-process surrogate Bayesian optimization (GPyOpt) is the AI method documented in the editorial source review.
